full_page.content:
Page 166 Cont.
Sep. 5 Edw'd R. Figlioli - 2 - 8 weeks infantile - back and right quite helpless. Inscribed today in Ser. Masses perpetual member John Reardon of Boston Mass - a fire-man missed. E'd Trees - 23 - reported "missing in action over Germany" 6 Valentine Mc Nutey - 44 - nerve-brk.
Ten ... air bombideers - reported "Missing in Action over Germ .! Treese among crew.
